note: What a server sends to say that a player has left the match, naming the client id they held. It shares the registration channel with Registered, from which its command value tells it apart.

fields.name: unused
fields.note: A client reads none of it; a server writes zero.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the player who left. A client drops the pair it holds for that client id; it reads nothing after it.
